blocks.text: The eligibility criteria for admission into UG & PG programmes are as per the norms approved by Government of Andhra Pradesh from time to time. The sanctioned seats in each program in the college are classified into CATEGORY – A and CATEGORY – B at first year level and Lateral Entry at second year level.
QIS College of engineering & Technology – EAMCET Code: QISE
Reservation Policy – Seats will be filled by the Govt. of Andhra Pradesh as per the Govt. approved Policy.
70% of seats will be filled by the Government of Andhra Pradesh as per the norms approved.
30% of seats will be filled by the College as per the norms approved by the Government of Andhra Pradesh.
Lateral entry candidates shall be admitted into the Third semester directly as per the norms approved by Government of Andhra Pradesh.
NOTE:The percentages of Category – A, Category – B and Lateral Entry Seats are decided time to time by the Government of Andhra Pradesh.
